# Reference field refresh controls

Original OOXML generated by `tools/reference_field_fixture.py` using only the
Python standard library. `source.docx` contains deliberately stale REF results
around one bookmark containing leading and trailing spaces. `expected.docx`
differs only in the three supported field caches: relative `below`, exact
bookmarked text and relative `above`. The unsupported paragraph-number switch
keeps its authored cache in both controls.

Browser comparisons require identical page pixels and geometry at zoom 1 and
.75 after explicit refresh. UI tests exercise F9, the localized retention
warning, one-step undo, unchanged package parts after undo and export/reopen.
Semantics follow ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.16.5.51, printed pages 1238–1239. These are
original paired controls, not native layout references.
